title: Mount /posts on dataparade.io and show recent posts from the newsroom
description: In DataParade-io/dataparade (landing): add the Papyrus edge (dataparade.anth.us) as an origin of the landing CloudFront distribution (domain-edge/template.yaml) with one /posts/* behavior (CachingDisabled, AllViewerExceptHostHeader); remove the build-time MDX posts (lib/posts.ts, app/posts, content/posts); have RecentPostsSection read /posts/_data/latest.json in the browser. Needs a dataparade.io deploy in account 688128002352, which needs the owner's go-ahead.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done 2026-10-22: dataparade.io/posts serves the newsroom projection. DataParade-io/dataparade PR #85 (branch feat/PPY-b63c46-posts-from-newsroom, open for review there): domain-edge ArticlesOrigin (dataparade.anth.us) with /posts and /posts/* behaviors (CachingDisabled, AllViewerExceptHostHeader), deployed with sam deploy after reviewing the change set (only LandingDistribution modified, no replacement); landing without the build-time MDX posts, home recent posts read /posts/_data/latest.json, deployed with sam-build.sh using the live GA/CookieYes/PostHog ids, then a /* invalidation. Production runs that branch until it merges. DataParade-newsroom #7/#8: productionUrl https://dataparade.io (canonical, sitemap, robots name dataparade.io). Verified live: dataparade.io/posts/, articles, latest.json, /posts -> /posts/, Markdown negotiation and bare /posts/<slug>.md (Papyrus 5.19.0, #9/#10) all work; landing home shows the four newest newsroom posts.
